verdict: untested for isomorphism (recipe-confounded); mechanism Goodhart-vulnerable (template collapse)
notes: S_held rose 2.1x (0.118 -> 0.252 over 20 rounds, n=96 held-out; two gstep-0 entries are independent pre-training measurements) while SWE-bench fell from the 0.04 base floor to 0.0 at all three milestones, with RepeatedAction dominating exits (19-21/25). Copy-paste Goodharting did NOT appear: 8-gram containment of z in e was 0.000 at base, step50, step250, step500, and step1000 (12 held-out samples each; see arms/abduction/thought_samples_*.jsonl). The Goodhart mode was instead template/mode collapse: median thought length shrank from ~205 words (base) to ~35 (step1000), and 5/12 step1000 thoughts were the identical generic sentence 'Let me check the environment state to understand what's happening' - the unbudgeted-z lift signal is exploitable by short generic filler that carries no world-state content. Caveat: ctrl_step250 also benched 0.0 with the same RepeatedAction profile, so the CE-backbone training itself collapses the policy and the bench differential vs ctrl has no dynamic range (floor effect); the abduction-specific contribution is indistinguishable from zero rather than measurably negative. Ops notes: patched a scorer bug on this pod (Scorer needed held-out rollouts merged into its cache, else S_held was nan every round); trained with batch 1/accum 16 + expandable_segments after CUDA OOM crashes at batch 2/accum 8 (effective batch unchanged at 16).
